sourceBranches: the quantity of unbalanced electricity in a body (either positive or negative) and construed as an excess or deficiency of electrons
accepted.simpleMeaning: the amount of unbalanced electricity held in a body or object, positive or negative, seen as too many or too few electrons
accepted.scope: This is the stored electrical imbalance itself, not the act of putting power into a battery and not the price asked for something.
examples: Rubbing the glass rod gave it a positive charge.
Opposite charges attract, while like charges push apart.
